name: fibonacci
description: Implement a function to calculate Fibonacci numbers

variants.typescript: Write a TypeScript function called `fibonacci` that takes a number `n` and returns the nth Fibonacci number. Include proper type annotations. Export the function.
variants.javascript: Write a JavaScript function called `fibonacci` that takes a number `n` and returns the nth Fibonacci number. Export the function.
variants.javascript-jsdoc: Write a JavaScript function called `fibonacci` that takes a number `n` and returns the nth Fibonacci number. Include JSDoc type annotations with @param and @return tags. Export the function.
